name: BGA Interposer Wizard
description: Generate BGA interposer footprints with configurable center and corner depopulation
description_full: A KiCad 10 footprint wizard for BGA-style interposers, based on KiCad's bundled BGA wizard. Overall rows and columns and center-opening rows and columns are independently configurable, with optional symmetric corner depopulation. An optional round NPTH can be placed in any package corner, with the footprint origin at either package center or hole center. Pad designators retain their full-grid locations across omitted positions.
